name: photofresco
description: Let AI agents edit images in a PhotoFresco window you approve: layers, masks, previews and export.

interface.longDescription: PhotoFresco lets your agent edit images in a PhotoFresco editor window on your computer: layers, masks, selections, adjustment layers, crop and resize, previews, undo and export. You approve the connection and each permission in the window and watch every edit. It needs Node.js 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium 120+. The server runs locally over stdio. Plugin installs grant no folders on disk: open images in the window yourself, or configure the server with --read/--write folders to let the agent open and save files.
capabilities: Edit images with layers and masks
defaultPrompt: Connect to PhotoFresco and warm up the highlights of the open image with a curves layer, then preview it.
In PhotoFresco, crop the open photo to 4:5, show me a preview, then undo if I don't like it.
